_comment: The chatgpt casing override. The -4o row also pins the DELIBERATE divergence between the two identifier builders: slugToIdentifier title-cases a single-char alpha suffix (4o -> 4O), whereas the Entity__ grammar preserves within-segment characters verbatim.
